question: Does the Official Compass bull/bear evidence balance carry usable direction for BTC/ETH over the next 1-7 days, beyond a no-direction forecast?

authority.site_label_required: Challenger B (forsøg) with its running track record; never presented as an Official Compass output or probability
authority.respects: OFFICIAL_COMPASS_BULL_BEAR_DISPLAY_v1 semantics EVIDENCE_BALANCE_NOT_PROBABILITY and site_synthesis_allowed=false: the mapping to a probability is B's registered model, computed server-side, not a site synthesis and not a Compass claim

inputs.a_issuance: the committed, digest-verified Challenger A weekly issuance (P0, sigma_hourly, day windows, T0)
inputs.kompas_packet: per horizon, the latest Official Compass packet issued in (T0-24h, T0] that also entered main (first-parent) by T0 and has status OK with integer bull+bear=10; otherwise no view

tilt_note: tilt=0.5 is a registered prior, frozen for the whole confirmatory period. It is NOT tuned on outcomes. An exploratory fit of the best tilt may be reported but can only seed a new pre-registered B2.

scoring.unit: asset-day (BTC, ETH; days 1-7 of the ISO week after T0)
scoring.outcome: 1[close at day end > P0]; a close equal to P0 is skipped
scoring.maturity: full hourly census of the day window, as in Challenger A
scoring.baseline: 0.25 (no-direction forecast p_up=0.5, i.e. Challenger A's untilted centre)
scoring.week_winner: B if the week's mean Brier < 0.25, BASE if > 0.25, else TIE (also TIE when B had no view)
secondary_descriptive: hit rate of the direction call

decision_rule.confirmatory_analysis: ONE analysis at exactly the first 8 non-tied prospective weeks; exact one-sided sign test in B's favour; B_HAS_DIRECTION iff >=7 of 8 (p=0.0352). Interim weeks descriptive only.
decision_rule.ties: excluded; a week where B has no view (all p_up = 0.5) is a tie
decision_rule.else: NO_PROVEN_DIRECTION: the live card keeps the line flat and says 'Ingen påvist retning'
never: tune tilt or the packet rule after W47 starts
use packets that entered main after T0
score a day without full hourly census
present B as the Official Compass

point_in_time_argument: B is a pure function of the frozen A issuance and packets already in main at T0, and this registration is committed (Bridge claude/log, timestamped) before the W47 T0. A B issuance computed later from those frozen inputs is therefore identical to one computed at T0; no outcome can enter it.
round3_firewall: not touched; no outcome scoring was run
falsification: If after 8 non-tied weeks B wins fewer than 7, the Kompas evidence balance has no proven 1-7 day direction at tilt 0.5, and the live card must not tilt the line.
